The PyTorch repository and source distributions reference several third-party
components. We list preserved source paths and governing license materials here.

Most entries below cover submodule-backed components referenced by this
repository. Their upstream license texts are preserved locally under
./licenses/, unless a specific entry points to a preserved component-local
LICENSE path instead.

Name: aiter
License: MIT
Files: ./aiter
  For details, see: ./licenses/aiter.LICENSE

Name: composable_kernel
License: MIT
Files: ./composable_kernel
  For details, see: ./licenses/composable_kernel.LICENSE

Name: cutlass-core
License: BSD-3-Clause
Files: ./cutlass (excluding ./cutlass/examples/python/CuTeDSL)
  For details, see: ./licenses/cutlass.LICENSE

Name: cutlass-cutedsl
License: NVIDIA EULA
Files: ./cutlass/examples/python/CuTeDSL
  For details, see: ./licenses/cutlass.CuTeDSL.EULA.txt
  Distribution note: Separately governed component; requires explicit
  compatibility review before public redistribution.
  Scope note: This entry covers the CuTeDSL subtree and the build-mirrored
  grouped_gemm.py path only; it does not reclassify unrelated vendored cutedsl
  files that retain their own in-tree headers.

Name: flash-attention
License: BSD-3-Clause
Files: ./flash-attention
  For details, see: ./licenses/flash-attention.LICENSE

Name: miniz-3.0.2
License: MIT
Files: ./miniz-3.0.2
  For details, see: ./miniz-3.0.2/LICENSE
